subject.title: fix: land ten small reliability fixes

question: After the CI/proof blockers are fixed, should maintainers land this consolidated reliability stack as one PR or split it back into narrower owner-specific fixes?
rationale: The PR is protected by the `maintainer` label and spans mobile, sandbox, provider/auth, cron, LSP, and install-policy boundaries, so the final landing shape is a maintainer ownership and review-scope decision.

options.title: Land Consolidated Stack
options.body: Fix the current blockers, require exact-head proof, and review this PR as the canonical landing path for the bundled fixes.

options.title: Split By Owner Surface
options.body: Ask for separate Android, iOS, sandbox, provider/auth, cron/LSP, and install-policy PRs if the combined blast radius is too high.

options.title: Defer To Source PRs
options.body: Pause this batch and continue with the individual linked PRs if their focused proof is easier to validate.

recommendation.title: Land Consolidated Stack
recommendation.body: Fix the current blockers, require exact-head proof, and review this PR as the canonical landing path for the bundled fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the consolidation author and also appear repeatedly in current-main history across several changed surfaces.
